title: Maths proof and evidence model
rules: MathClaim states the proposition being established.
MathAssumptions records the assumptions under which a claim is evaluated.
MathProofPolicy supports STANDARD, STRONG, CERTIFIED and DIAGNOSTIC planning.
MathProofRoute distinguishes OBLIGATION routes from SUPPORT diagnostics.
MathProofAttempt retains each executed route and its result.
STRONG may return CORROBORATION_REQUIRED/INDETERMINATE when an independent supporting path disagrees even when a narrower obligation is proved.
CERTIFIED requires exact, exact-bound, symbolic or rigorous-enclosure evidence appropriate to the stated claim.
Full MathProof canonical records can be SHA-256 sealed; mutation must invalidate the seal.
